meta_title: Golden Heating & Plumbing | Gas Engineer Rochdale
meta_description: Golden Heating & Plumbing provides expert gas engineering and plumbing services across Rochdale. Fast response, reliable repairs. Call now for a quote.
hero_subhead: Boiler breakdown at 2am? We arrive fast and fix it right. Same-day repairs, transparent pricing, no surprises.
services_heading: Complete Heating & Plumbing Services Across Rochdale
services_subhead: From emergency boiler repairs to full central heating installations, we handle every job with care and speed.

services.title: Emergency Boiler Repair
services.desc: Your boiler's stopped working — we diagnose the fault and fix it fast, often the same day. We carry common parts on the van to minimise downtime.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: New combi boiler, system boiler, or heat-only install. We handle everything: pipework, radiators, controls. Ten-year manufacturer warranty included.

services.title: Boiler Servicing & Maintenance
services.desc: Annual gas safety check keeps your boiler running smoothly and your insurance valid. Catch small faults before they become expensive.

services.title: Burst Pipe & Leak Repair
services.desc: Leaking radiator, burst pipe, or water damage? We respond quickly to contain damage and get your system back to normal.

services.title: Radiator Replacement & Balancing
services.desc: Cold spots in your home? We replace faulty radiators or balance your system so heat distributes evenly throughout.

services.title: Powerflush & System Cleaning
services.desc: Improve boiler efficiency and heating performance by removing sludge and debris from your pipework. Often cuts energy bills by 10–15%.

about_pullquote: I started this job because I was fed up seeing folks overcharged for honest work.
about_para_1: Golden Heating & Plumbing was founded on a simple belief: charge a fair price, turn up on time, and treat your home the way we'd treat our own. Over nearly two decades, we've built a reputation in Rochdale and Greater Manchester for reliability, speed, and no-nonsense service. We're Gas Safe Registered and fully insured, so you know you're in safe hands.
about_para_2: Our repeat customer rate speaks volumes. People trust us because we're honest about what needs fixing, we give you options, and we don't disappear after the job's done. Whether it's a midnight emergency or a planned boiler install, we show up prepared, work clean, and leave you confident.
reviews_heading: What Rochdale Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Boiler packed up on a Sunday afternoon — I was panicking. Called Golden and they came out within the hour. Turned out to be the pump, fixed it straightaway and the cost was less than the quote. Professional bloke, knew exactly what he was doing. Top marks.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had a new combi boiler installed from start to finish. They explained everything, did the job cleanly, and left the place spotless. The paperwork's all sorted and they even rang to check everything was working a week later. Will definitely be back for the annual service.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Came to fix a radiator leak at short notice. No fuss, no drama, got it sorted in half an hour for a fair price. Been using them for three years now — never let us down. Highly recommend if you need a proper gas engineer.
reviews.author: David P.
